description: TU Delft and University of Genoa researchers publish simulated hydrodynamic resistance for parametrically varied ship hulls. Free-Form Deformation generates the geometry variations, which are analysed with high-fidelity CFD. The release includes geometry, hydrostatic and stability parameters, operating conditions and resistance outputs. These data train and benchmark physically constrained resistance surrogate models. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: tool-specific files, source scripts. Licence: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: CFD outputs are simulated evidence. Numerical accuracy and generalisation were not independently reproduced. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
